A '''Startlevine''' is an {{Epic}} [[Mutation]].

== Obtaining ==
A '''Startlevine''' can grow in the [[Greenhouse]] if there are {{Item|Blastberry|amount=4}} and {{Item|Cheesebite|amount=4}} within {{Green|1}} block of farmland.

While growing, a '''Startlevine''' needs water and has {{Green|12}} {{Dark Green|Growth Stages}}. When placed near another crop, it retains watering status by {{Green|100%}}, increases {{Skill|Farming}} experience by {{Green|30%}} and reduces yield by {{Red|-20%}}.

'''Startlevine''' requires {{PotN|Invisibility}} to be harvested.

== Crop Drops ==
When harvested, '''Startlevines''' also drop {{Item|Cactus|amount=2250}}, {{Item|Sugar Cane|amount=3000}}, and {{Skill XP|12000 Farming}}.

== Usage ==
=== Crop Analyzer ===
A '''Startlevine''' can be analyzed in the [[Crop Analyzer]] for {{c|500k}}. When analyzed, it grants {{Copper|250}}. The first time analyzing a '''Startlevine''' grants an additional {{Copper|1,000}}.

=== Mutations ===
'''Startlevines''' are used to create a {{Item|Glasscorn}}.

== Tips ==
*A '''Startlevine''' can be harvested without losing {{Stat|Farming Fortune}} by consuming or getting splashed with an {{PotN|Invisibility|pot=y}}, or gaining temporary invisibility through the {{Item|Great Spook Staff}}'s {{AN|Spook}} ability.
**If {{Stat|Farming Fortune}} is not a concern, {{Item|Sorrow Armor}} and {{Item|Shadow Assassin Helmet}}'s ability can also be used.
*Since {{Item|Blastberry}} is required to grow '''Startlevine''', any '''Startlevine''' actively growing will be destroyed if the {{Item|Blastberry}} decays.
